title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
description:
UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do:

  • Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.

  • Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.

  • Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.

  • Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.

  • Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.

  • Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.

  • Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.

  • Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.


Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.

  • Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.

  • Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.

  • Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.

  • Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Technical Support helps customers and internal teams get the most from Airwallex’s products after integration. You’ll investigate complex technical issues, turn recurring problems into practical guidance, and help coordinate clear responses when incidents affect customers.

  • Support developers, merchants and internal teams with post-integration issues, providing technical guidance, consulting and best practices.

  • Investigate issues across code, software, hardware, devices and endpoints by designing and running test scenarios.

  • Configure test environments, payment APIs and ecommerce products to reproduce issues and support effective resolution.

  • Communicate technical issues clearly to customers and internal teams, identifying irregularities and unexpected behaviour in Airwallex products and services.

  • Create practical technical resources, including sample code, log-searching guidance and FAQs, for customers and internal teams.

  • Coordinate communication and responses between clients, internal stakeholders and senior leadership during global incident management.

  • Support occasional weekend and holiday on-call coverage as the business requires.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in programming, technical support, implementation or a related role.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and appropriately with customers and internal teams.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong prioritisation, organisation and attention to detail when managing multiple urgent issues in parallel.

  • Sufficient technical knowledge to communicate effectively with Engineering and Product teams.

  • A strong commitment to providing exceptional customer service.

  • The ability to learn new technologies and products quickly.

  • Experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, PHP, C#, JavaScript or shell scripting.

  • Familiarity with web technologies, HTTP and HTTPS.

  • Experience with REST, JSON, SOAP and SQL.

  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Splunk and Grafana.

  • Willingness to participate in occasional weekend and holiday on-call coverage.

Preferred

  • Experience in ecommerce, payments or fintech.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

Merchant Services at Airwallex is made up of two teams: Solutions Engineering and Technical Support, working together to turn customer-facing technical work into product progress. Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

The mandate is simple: solve for the customer in front of us, and build for the customers we haven't met yet. Sitting close to Product, Engineering, and Design means the patterns you see in real customer integrations can become better APIs, documentation, tooling, onboarding paths, and product capabilities. The hard part is doing both at once: shipping for today's customer without losing the signal that improves the product for the next.

This is a team for people who can earn trust with builders, reason through complex systems, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in commercial outcomes. If you want to work at the intersection of agentic finance, customer impact, and product development, this is where your work compounds.

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
Artemis is building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, helping companies defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

Our platform brings a new approach to the $100B security operations market, building a live model of each customer's environment and using AI agents to detect, investigate, hunt, and respond to threats at machine speed. Just one year after our founding, Artemis is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies of all time, with customers including multiple Fortune 500 companies, Global 2000 enterprises, and AI innovators like Cursor.

We have raised $70M from Felicis, First Round Capital, Theory Ventures, Two Sigma Ventures, Lockstep VC and Brightmind. We are also backed by some of the most prominent operators in cybersecurity, including the CEO of Crowdstrike, the former CEO and CTO of Splunk, and the founders of Abnormal AI and Demisto.

Artemis's founders have built and scaled security products used by tens of thousands of customers. Shachar Hirshberg (CEO) led Amazon GuardDuty, the world's largest cloud detection product, was an early employee at Demisto, the company that invented the SOAR category, was an engineering leader at Palo Alto Networks, and holds an MBA from Harvard. Dan Shiebler (CTO) led all AI and machine learning at Abnormal AI, the pioneer of behavior-based detection, spent five years building analytics using machine learning and vector databases at Twitter, and holds a PhD in machine learning from Oxford.

Our team of software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers comes from Google, Meta, AWS, Wiz, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Abnormal AI, Perplexity, Bridgewater, Mercor, CERN, and more.

We're growing fast and looking for builders who want to help us serve our rapidly expanding customer base.

The Role

As our first EMEA Channel Sales Manager, you'll own building Artemis's indirect go-to-market motion in the UK and Europe. You'll identify, recruit, and enable strategic partners (Distributors Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) to sell Artemis into new and existing customer base. You'll develop partner programs, provide enablement and support, manage partner relationships, and ensure partners are generating pipeline and closing deals.

This role is critical to scaling beyond direct sales. You'll have autonomy to shape our channel strategy, build partner relationships from scratch, and drive significant revenue through indirect channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and recruit strategic channel partners (Distributors, Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) across the UK and Europe

  • Develop and manage partnership agreements, pricing structures, and incentive programs

  • Onboard new partners and provide initial enablement (product training, positioning, sales tools, technical certification)

  • Build partner success playbooks—what works, what messaging lands, how to close deals

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to monitor pipeline, revenue, and performance

  • Support partner sales teams on complex deals (technical questions, customer introductions, deal strategy)

  • Co-market with partners (joint webinars, events, case studies, campaigns)

  • Manage partner portal, training materials, and go-to-market resources

  • Build forecasting models around partner revenue and pipeline

  • Identify gaps in partner coverage and recruit to fill them

  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs and partner success

  • Hit revenue targets tied to partner-sourced deals and pipeline

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in channel sales, partner sales, or indirect go-to-market roles in B2B technology or cybersecurity

  • Proven track record building channel programs from scratch or scaling existing programs

  • Strong understanding of partner types (Distributors, Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) and how to recruit, enable, and manage them

  • Experience managing multiple partners simultaneously and hitting revenue targets

  • Deep network in the UK/European cybersecurity or enterprise technology space (or ability to build one quickly)

  • Comfortable negotiating partnerships, pricing, and incentive structures

  • Strong presentation and communication skills—you'll train partners and present to leadership

  • Project management skills—you'll own multiple workstreams and timelines

  • CRM and sales ops experience (Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar)

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building processes from scratch

Nice to Have

  • Cybersecurity or security product expertise

  • Experience building MDF (Marketing Development Funds) or partner incentive programs

  • Regional presence and relationships in UK/Europe

  • Experience at early-stage SaaS companies scaling go-to-market

title: Legal Counsel (Commercial Contracts and Regulatory)
description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi's Legal team is small, senior and hands-on. We draft, negotiate and advise ourselves, and we bring in outside counsel only where local law or deal complexity demands it. This role sits inside that team, reporting to the Deputy GC, and owns the contracts that keep our payment infrastructure running: card acquiring, payment processing, banking and payout partners, and the technology and outsourcing agreements behind them.

You will work closely with Payments, Partnerships, Product, Compliance and Finance across our regulated entities in the UK, Ireland and Norway. The regulatory advice you give will shape the contracts you negotiate, and the contracts you negotiate will directly affect how fast LemFi can move with new partners and products.

What you'll build and own

  • Draft, review and negotiate payment processing, card acquiring, PSP, banking, safeguarding, payout and aggregator agreements, end to end.

  • Handle technology, SaaS and outsourcing contracts, including the ICT requirements under DORA and outsourcing rules for regulated firms.

  • Run the day-to-day contract flow through Jira and SpotDraft: NDAs, DPAs, amendments, renewals and terminations, turned around quickly.

  • Apply and develop the LemFi contracting playbook, templates and fallback positions so the business can move faster on repeat deal types.

  • Advise Payments and Partnerships on payments and e-money regulation across the UK, Ireland and Norway, covering PSRs 2017, EMRs 2011 and Irish and Norwegian equivalents.

  • Review customer T&Cs, product changes and marketing for regulatory compliance, and track incoming reforms such as the EU payments package.

  • Use AI-assisted contract review and drafting tools to handle a high volume of work without sacrificing accuracy, flagging where your own judgement overrides the output.

Your experience

  • Qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales or Ireland, or as an advokat in Norway, with 3 to 6 years' PQE.

  • Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating payment processing, acquiring, banking or payment partner agreements, at a law firm or in-house.

  • Working knowledge of payments and e-money regulation in the UK or EU, including the Payment Services Regulations 2017 or the Electronic Money Regulations 2011.

  • Experience with technology and outsourcing contracts in a regulated environment.

  • Comfortable managing a high volume of contracts, setting your own priorities and turning work around at pace.

  • Clear, commercial communicator: you write for non-lawyers without losing the legal precision that matters.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with card scheme rules (Visa, Mastercard) and their application to acquiring and issuing contracts.

  • Experience with DORA or equivalent ICT/operational resilience frameworks for regulated firms.

  • Fluency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, relevant for the Oslo base.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

What that looks like day to day

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you're selling into the biggest and most complex accounts we go after, the ones where an incident going badly becomes a board-level problem. Intercom, Etsy, Miro, HashiCorp and StubHub are already customers, so you're not cold-starting a story nobody believes. The product has real market fit and it is nowhere near fully capitalised. That gap is the whole opportunity.

The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. Enterprise cycles here mean six or seven decision-makers, technical buyers who will test you properly, and C-level conversations where you need to be credible immediately. You'll run demos alongside SE's, and the feedback you bring back goes to a product team that ships in hours and days, not quarters.

Sales isn't a function bolted onto the side of this business, it's central to how we win. You'll work with leadership on building sales process rather than inheriting a finished one, and challenging how we do things is the job itself, not something you get credit for on top.

We're AI-forward, founded by engineers, and everyone here has unlimited Claude access. We expect you to use it properly: researching accounts, prepping deals, and moving faster than the rep across the table at a legacy vendor.

Who you are

  • You've closed $100k+ new business at the top end of enterprise, and you can talk me through how you actually did it, not just what the number was.

  • You're comfortable in a room full of engineers and CTOs. Technical buyers don't faze you, and you know the difference between selling to them and selling at them.

  • You're a proper hunter. You've got more than one way into an account, and a run of rejection doesn't take the wind out of you.

  • You build the case with evidence. Data, the right customer story, real product knowledge, whatever it takes to move that particular stakeholder.

  • Multi-threading is instinct, not technique. You assume there are six people on the other side of the deal and you'd rather know all of them.

  • You've got opinions about the product and you share them. The best reps here are the ones product actually listens to.

  • Startup ambiguity suits you. The playbook is half-written, nobody is going to hand you a process, and you'd rather help build one.

  • You're good to work with. You'll be close to leadership, SEs and CSMs, and you care about being someone people want in the room.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

You'll do it at the frontier of AI in fleet insurance, in a heavily AI-powered business where AI is driving impact in every team.

You'll own Flock's marketing strategy, brand and budget, reporting to our co-founder and Chief Commercial Officer. We've dramatically increased the marketing budget because we're planning to go big, and you'll have a Marketing Manager reporting to you who owns events and content delivery. You'll set the direction, but this is still a hands-on role for someone who gets things done, with a run-until-tackled mindset and the drive to show how far a small, AI-native team can go.

Brand and launches. Flock has been through its acquisition by Admiral, and the Flock and Admiral Business propositions will become increasingly connected from here. You'll be central to taking that joined-up offer to market, owning how Flock by Admiral looks and sounds everywhere and leading every launch end to end. It's the best of both worlds, a fun, high-energy brand combined with the strongest name in UK insurance.

Growth. Every fleet we insure comes to us through an insurance broker, so brokers sit at the centre of how we grow. You'll build the campaigns, events strategy and broker programmes that grow both, alongside distribution, underwriting and product, and show what each pound returns.

AI. Our marketing is already heavily AI-powered, across design, web, email and video. You'll take it much further, building tools, agents and workflows so a team of two produces the output of ten, and you'll be the person Flock and Admiral turn to when they want to see what's possible next.   • Build with AI. Create tools and workflows, and share them so the whole business moves faster.

Healthcare Sites Development Manager

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

💡 The Missions

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in Île-de-France, built to rethink occupational health with Alan's technology, for the benefit of employees and of healthcare professionals (HPs).

Its first medical centre opened at Valmy (Paris 10th) in April 2026, and 4 sites are already running.

Prévenir is about to scale fast: the ambition is to open several new small centres around Paris in 2027 (Seine-et-Marne, Val-d'Oise), first inside ready-to-operate sites, then in premises of its own (rented or bought), including a flagship centre in Paris. The exact plan is still being shaped, and you will help shape it.

We are looking for someone senior and visionary enough to carry the vision and strategy of Prévenir's sites from day one, while being happy (and excited) to be hands-on as much as needed, with a start-up mindset. Health, member experience and innovation are at the heart of the role.

You would join Alan as a full-time Alaner in the Workplace team: you work for Alan, not only for Prévenir. You will work alongside the Facility Manager in charge of Alan's offices at Valmy, and turn what you learn into playbooks, checklists and templates (openings, fit-out, vendors, compliance) that serve Prévenir's centres as much as Alan's own offices.

The position is based in Paris, with regular field visits across Île-de-France (Paris, Seine-et-Marne, Hauts-de-Seine, Val-d'Oise), and requires an onsite or field presence at least 4 days per week.

Set the vision

  • Bring innovation: test new centre formats (shared, modular or temporary sites), and have a smart use of AI to make each opening faster, cheaper and better for HPs and patients

Open and build new sites

  • Find and technically qualify new sites: define search criteria with the Occupational Health team, visit candidate sites, and give a clear go / no-go recommendation with an estimated cost

  • Open small centres inside ready-to-operate sites: check that the host site works for medical use, agree the terms with the host operator (services, charges, service levels, who does what), do the light set-up and prepare the opening

  • Prepare and negotiate leases with Legal and Finance, and be the single operational point of contact for landlords, architects and vendors

  • When relevant, lead fit-out works end to end: brief and manage architects, project managers and contractors, plan backwards from the opening date, secure administrative and safety authorisations, manage acceptance and close snags

  • Contribute to the rent vs buy thinking by providing technical due diligence on any potential acquisition (condition of the building, works to expect, regulatory constraints, running costs)

Make every centre medical-ready, unique, safe and healthy

  • Make every site ready for patients: consultation rooms, patient flows, confidentiality (acoustics), hygiene and cleaning, medical waste, hand-washing points, IT / network and badge access set up with the IT team

  • Own the safety and security of every centre, for patients, HPs and visitors: access control, intrusion alarms and video surveillance where relevant (in line with GDPR), fire safety, evacuation procedures and drills, first-aid kits and defibrillators where required, and clear procedures for incidents and for HPs working alone

  • Put prevention at the heart of the run: identify the main risk areas of each centre (fire safety, HVAC and air quality, water, electrical, access control), build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep each site's safety register up to date

Run the centres day to day

  • Run the day-to-day for existing and new centres with the center managers (ASSTs): sort and diagnose requests, fix what can be fixed, send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until it is done and checked

  • Own the logistical run of the centres in partnership with the center managers: supplies, snacks, mail, printing, small furniture and IT equipment, access and badges, cleaning. Agree a clear split of who does what and give them simple routines, checklists and documentation so they become autonomous

  • Create and keep alive the Prévenir spirit in every centre, as the Workplace team does for Alan its own offices: a welcoming, consistent and on-brand place for HPs, ASSTs and patients, using their feedback to keep improving it

Manage vendors, budgets and playbooks

  • Build a standard vendor panel (maintenance, fire safety, cleaning, medical waste, access control, furniture) with SLAs, penalties and exit terms. Run tenders and invoice checks, and reuse contracts across sites

  • Own the budget with Finance and the Occupational Health team: capex (fit-out, equipment, furniture) and opex (rent, charges, maintenance) per site, monthly follow-up, and realistic figures to feed the medical centres business model

  • Track, improve and document: run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, openings progress, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write the opening playbook and technical checklist reused for each new site

  • Take part in the team's rituals and priorities, work with Alan's Workplace scope and join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks)

  • The new centres planned for 2027 open on time, with safety, accessibility and authorisations validated before the first patient and a budget under control

  • A replicable opening playbook, a building technical checklist, a standard vendor panel and standard contract templates are in place and reused across sites

  • Every centre feels like Prévenir, is safe and secure (access control, alarms and emergency procedures in place and tested, drills done on time), and is healthy.

  • A site or contract manager at an FM service provider (healthcare accounts) who wants to move in-house, or a Workplace / Facility Manager in a scale-up who has led several office openings or moves

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of buildings: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems, doors and access control, and the ability to challenge a technician or an architect

  • Proven experience of opening or fitting out sites: works follow-up with architects, project managers and contractors, planning, acceptance, snags

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for public-access buildings (ERP classification, safety commission, works authorisation, accessibility, mandatory periodic checks, safety register)

  • Good knowledge of site safety and security: access control, intrusion alarms, video surveillance (and related GDPR rules), evacuation and emergency procedures, incident management

  • Lease and landlord management: you can read a lease, understand who pays and does what, and negotiate with landlords and agents

  • Proven vendor and contract management (SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control) and budget ownership (capex / opex per site, total cost of ownership)

  • Project management of several sites in parallel, with strong prioritisation, including urgent incidents

  • Ability to work with senior and varied stakeholders: HPs and doctors, directors, Legal, Finance, IT, landlords, architects

  • Senior enough to set a vision and a strategy, and to carry and defend it with Prévenir's leadership and Alan, with a start-up mindset: frugal, fast, comfortable building from scratch with changing priorities, and happy to be hands-on

  • Mobility across Île-de-France (Paris, 77, 92, 95 and more)

  • Visionary and hands-on, autonomous and proactive, at ease with ambiguity while the plan (number of sites, rent vs buy, timing) is still evolving, calm when things don't go as planned, and discreet and respectful of the medical environment

Nice to have

  • Experience of medical, paramedical or health-related sites (centres de santé, clinics, labs), including ERP type U requirements

  • A technical diploma or certification (BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP) and electrical habilitation

  • Experience of a technical due diligence on a building purchase, or of a sale-and-leaseback / long-lease structure

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy-efficiency projects

title: Médecin du travail
description:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

🩺 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes médecin du travail référent sur un portefeuille d'entreprises adhérentes, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes:

  • Coordonner les trois missions des SPSTI (suivi individuel, action en milieu de travail, prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle) sur votre périmètre d'entreprises adhérentes, avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire que vous animez : IDEST, ASST, IPRP

  • Innovation et amélioration continue: test et déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques en santé au travail, optimisation des protocoles, collaboration avec les équipes de développement, etc.

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

title: Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 (Master ou diplôme d’ingénieur) en photonique, optique, électronique, mécanique, physique appliquée, physique de la matière condensée ou dans un domaine connexe. Un doctorat (PhD) serait apprécié.
  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail
      • Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux

Processus de recrutement :

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. Rattaché.e au responsable développement informatique, le.a Référent.e Technique Informatique :

  • Coordonne le travail d’une équipe de développement de logiciels.


Dans le détail, les missions :


  • Participer au chiffrage de nouveaux projets avec l’équipe commerciale,
  • Planifier, coordonner et suivre des projets de développement de logiciels pilotant un dispositif,
  • Définir le contour, les exigences et les spécifications techniques du projet en relation avec les partenaires concernés (client directement et/ou chef de projet interne du produit),
  • Organiser le travail d’une équipe technique logiciel dans le respect des plannings et du budget, selon les spécifications requises par le client,
  • Être l’interface privilégiée des clients sur le ou les projets pris en charge pour les sujets logiciels,
  • Contribuer à la structuration documentaire des projets (cahiers des charges, architecture, spécifications, rapports, etc.),
  • Assurer la coordination avec le reste de l’équipe R&D et le client,
  • Participer à la réalisation des développements (architecture, codage en appoint des développeurs)
  • Spécifier, concevoir et réaliser les tests,
  • Participer à la gestion des fournisseurs et sous-traitants impliqués dans les projets
  • Veiller au respect des réglementations en vigueur (IEC 62304) avec le support de l’équipe qualité/réglementaire.


♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ?

Tu es ingénieur.e de formation ou équivalent, et tu disposes d’une expérience réussie (environ 10 ans) dans la gestion de projets techniques, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé ou dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux.

Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension des systèmes pluridisciplinaires (robotique, mécatronique, automatisme) et tu maîtrises les méthodologies de développement logiciel ainsi que les approches Agile. Tu es également à l’aise avec les outils DevOps et tu maîtrises le développement en C# ou en C++.

Tu sais piloter un projet de bout en bout (planning, budget, jalons, reporting), coordonner des équipes aux expertises variées et arbitrer les sujets complexes avec pragmatisme. Une connaissance des normes applicables aux dispositifs médicaux (IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 13485, ISO 14971) est un véritable plus.

Au-delà de tes compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité. Curieux.se et passionné.e par la technologie, tu aimes innover et relever des défis.

Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’organisation et d’autonomie, tout en appréciant le travail collectif. Ton sens de l’écoute, tes qualités de communication et ton orientation client te permettent de créer des relations de confiance et de faire avancer les projets dans un esprit de collaboration.

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

.

We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. When people gain access to this insight, mental barriers transform into opportunities for personal growth, leading to a more fulfilling and happy life. And because happiness is contagious, society changes—one mind at a time.

You studied psychology. Now what?

You love psychology. You've spent years learning how people think, feel and change. But you don't see yourself in a therapy room every day, and the other doors everyone points you to don't feel quite right either.

There is another one. At Aepsy, you'll work with psychologists instead of patients: finding them, supporting them, growing a community together and helping them build a practice they love. Your psychology background isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the reason psychologists will trust you.

The role

As Community Manager Romandie, you own our community of French-speaking psychologists in Switzerland, as part of our Community & Operations team in Zurich alongside the leads for our German-, Italian- and English-speaking communities. You find and onboard psychologists, you are their first point of contact, help them with administrative and everyday questions, and look out for new opportunities so they can bloom. Together, we will shape the role around your strengths and passions. This is a starting position designed to grow fast, with real ownership from your first weeks.

Together with us

We are a vibrant team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs, and we genuinely love what we do. We love conversations about the big picture as much as the smallest details. We work hard to make the world a slightly better place.

At the same time, we are mothers, fathers, husbands and wives, wine lovers, stand-up comedians, musicians, dancers, yoga practitioners, and Zen monks who appreciate and enjoy life.

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

title: hbo-stage Bedrijfskunde: Digitalisering en Procesoptimalisatie van communicatie
description:
hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die enthousiaste hbo-student die het leuk vindt om organisatievraagstukken te onderzoeken en processen te verbeteren?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) wil het gebruik van papieren post verminderen en de mogelijkheden voor digitale communicatie verder uitbreiden. Dit geldt zowel voor de communicatie met bedrijven als met personen. Tijdens deze stage richt je je specifiek op de communicatie met individuele onderzoekspersonen.

Op dit moment benadert het CBS onderzoekspersonen in eerste instantie vrijwel altijd via een brief op het huisadres. Digitale communicatie, bijvoorbeeld via e-mail, biedt kansen om dit proces efficiënter, flexibeler en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Er lopen binnen het CBS al verschillende initiatieven om meer gebruik te maken van e-mailadressen, maar er zijn ook nog belangrijke vraagstukken die onderzocht moeten worden.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de volgende vragen:

  • Hoe kan het CBS op een effectieve manier e-mailadressen van onderzoekspersonen verzamelen en beheren?

  • Welke juridische en privacyvoorwaarden gelden voor het opbouwen en gebruiken van een e-maildatabase?

  • Welke technische aanpassingen en voorzieningen zijn nodig om digitale communicatie mogelijk te maken?

  • Hoe moeten de bestaande werkprocessen worden aangepast om digitale communicatie goed te ondersteunen?

  • Hoe kunnen we ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekspersonen op een toegankelijke en betrouwbare manier digitaal benaderd worden?

Samen met het Waarneeminnovatie Team en collega's van de afdeling Dataverzameling ga je dit vraagstuk onderzoeken. Je brengt de huidige situatie in kaart, onderzoekt mogelijkheden voor verbetering en werkt toe naar concrete aanbevelingen voor het CBS.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je gaat aan de slag in het Team Waarneeminnovatie. Dit team valt binnen de afdeling Dataverzameling. We zijn een jong, divers en vooral enthousiast team dat als doel heeft de waarneming van het CBS te vernieuwen en te verbeteren. 

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een hbo-opleiding Bedrijfskunde of een soortgelijke opleiding.

  • Je hebt interesse in procesoptimalisatie, digitalisering en organisatieverandering.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, onderzoekend en neemt graag initiatief.

  • Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende betrokkenen binnen een organisatie in gesprek te gaan.

  • Je hebt een proactieve, positieve en assertieve houding en denkt in oplossingen, staat open voor feedback en gaat uitdagingen met enthousiasme aan.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • samen met ervaren vakmensen bestaande processen analyseert en verbeterkansen herkent;

  • zelfstandig een praktijkgericht onderzoek of experiment opzet;

  • aan de slag gaat met het in kaart brengen van verschillende organisatorische, juridische en technische belangen en randvoorwaarden rondom digitale communicatie;

  • leert om onderzoeksresultaten te vertalen naar concrete, onderbouwde en uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor het CBS.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Backend Developer (Python, Java)
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we've been building that knowledge for over 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we're also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax advisors don't just get an answer, but an answer they're willing to attach their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it daily, generating over 100 million euros in ARR across Europe. We're looking for a Medior Backend Developer to help build that.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

Lawyers and tax advisors ask a question in GenIA-L and get a reliable answer. That answer is what they see. What you build is everything needed to make it happen: the backend. These are the systems and connections that keep our AI product fast, secure and reliable. You join the AI team and work with our AI engineers every day. They make the product smart; you make sure that intelligence actually reaches the user. After six months, you know the code well and have shipped several new features. After that, you choose the direction you want to grow in: more towards AI, for example by improving the quality of our AI answers, or more towards DevOps, for example by improving how we automatically test and release software.

  • You build and maintain the backend of our main AI product, together with our AI engineers.

  • You build APIs and services: the connections that let the different parts of the platform talk to each other.

  • You keep an eye on code quality and make sure we follow good practices and standards.

  • You monitor and maintain our live applications and fix problems when something goes wrong.

  • You bring your own ideas on how to improve the product and the way we work.

  • You are proactive, enthusiastic, and take initiative.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently, conveying information in a concise and engaging manner.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You pick up your work independently. You don’t need much guidance, but you know when to involve a colleague.

  • You have opinions and you are not afraid to share them.

  • And you enjoy working with AI specialists on a product that is still very much in development.

  • At least 3 years of experience building Python applications that run in production and are actually used by customers.

  • Experience with FastAPI and Pydantic. Experience with LangChain or LangGraph is a plus.

  • You have built production-grade APIs that work reliably for real users.

  • You work independently within a team and don’t need hand-holding.

  • Knowledge of Postgres, GraphQL or MongoDB is a plus.

  • Some DevOps knowledge is nice to have, for example working with GitHub Actions and Helm.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

You join the AI team with one other backend engineer, three AI engineers and a Product Owner. You also work closely with the search team, the frontend team and our backend and AI leads. You report to our Lead Backend Engineer. You get a lot of freedom and room for your own opinions and ideas, in a fun team with a good work-life balance. And you can grow into a Senior or Lead Backend Engineer role.

  • A monthly base salary up to €5500 and a standard 36-hour working week.

  • An end-of-year bonus of 4% of your gross annual salary and a variable profit share of up to 6% of your gross annual salary.

  • 23 holidays and a 12% personal benefits budget, of which 8% is holiday allowance and 4% you can spend freely, for example on extra days off.

  • A good pension plan through PGB, including additional partner insurance.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometre or a public transport allowance, plus an attractive bike scheme. For employees who travel less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Hybrid working: two days a week at our office in The Hague, on Tuesday and Thursday.

  • Room to grow. In your field, in your role, in the organisation.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We'd love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within a few business days. Have a few questions first? Message or call Nadine at 0628556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

 

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

 

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

 

Dit ga je doen:

  • Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren.

  • Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties.

  • Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht.

  • Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen.

  • Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren.

  • Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

 

Team
Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR.

 

Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s.

 

De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component.

⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste.

⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist.

⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken.

⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten.

⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden.

 

Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position.

 

Wat wij bieden:

title: Senior Projectmanager
description:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Stage HR | Recruitment & People Development
description:
Van het vinden van de juiste kandidaat tot de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe collega: er gebeurt veel voor en na de eerste werkdag. In deze meeloopstage krijg je de kans om beide kanten te ontdekken en werk je mee binnen Corporate Recruitment en Leren & Ontwikkelen.

Je doet dit binnen Retail & Logistiek, waar we werken aan IT-oplossingen, procesondersteuning en dienstverlening voor organisaties in de retail- en logistieke sector. Je krijgt hierdoor te maken met verschillende functies en vakgebieden en helpt mee om nieuwe collega’s te vinden en medewerkers verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Corporate Recruitment

Binnen Corporate Recruitment werk je mee aan het aantrekken en selecteren van nieuwe collega’s. Daarbij draait het om het vinden van een goede match, zowel voor de kandidaat als voor Centric. Je gaat onder andere:

  • Vacatures opstellen en publiceren

  • Actief zoeken en benaderen van kandidaten

  • Ondersteunen bij de eerste screening en kandidaatcommunicatie

  • Meewerken aan employer branding, content en recruitmentcampagnes

  • Recruitmentdata analyseren

Leren & Ontwikkelen

Binnen Leren & Ontwikkelen werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van medewerkers binnen Centric. Je kijkt naar wat medewerkers nodig hebben om te blijven leren en ondersteunt bij het aanbieden en verbeteren van leeractiviteiten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Je gaat onder andere:

  • Ondersteunen bij de organisatie en communicatie rondom leeractiviteiten

  • Bijeenkomsten en workshops voorbereiden en organiseren

  • Leer- en ontwikkelbehoeften inventariseren

  • Meewerken aan het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van leerpaden

  • Ondersteunen bij de verdere ontwikkeling van de Centric Academy

  • Leeractiviteiten evalueren en feedback vertalen naar verbeteringen

Dit krijg je

  • Een afwisselende meeloopstage waarin je ervaring opdoet met Corporate Recruitment en Leren & Ontwikkelen.

  • Goede begeleiding en ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ideeën.

  • Een laptop van de zaak

  • Een stagevergoeding van €550 per maand op basis van 40 uur per week

  • Toegang tot de Centric Academy

  • Leuke activiteiten en borrels

Dit breng je mee

Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van bijvoorbeeld HRM, Bedrijfskunde, International Business, Toegepaste Psychologie, Communicatie of een vergelijkbare studie. Daarnaast:

  • Heb je interesse in recruitment en leren & ontwikkelen

  • Ben je communicatief vaardig

  • Werk je gestructureerd en zelfstandig

  • Neem je graag initiatief en pak je nieuwe werkzaamheden gemakkelijk op

  • Vind je het interessant om met data te werken en verbeteringen te ontdekken

  • Beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Wij zijn Centric, een IT-software en services bedrijf dat verweven zit in de Nederlandse Maatschappij. Vaak zie je ons logo niet op onze producten, maar ze worden gebruikt door o.a. gemeenten, grote retailers, banken en ziekenhuizen. Door bij ons te werken omring je jezelf met kansen. Kansen om impact te maken terwijl jij jezelf ontwikkelt! Geïnteresseerd? Neem vooral even contact op!

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan via de button. Heb je vragen? Dan kan je contact opnemen met onze Campus Recruiter, Nicolle, via  of +316 10 63 99 27.
