title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
location: Austria,  France,  Germany,  Ireland,  Netherlands,  Spain,  UK
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Enterprise Sales Executive, AI Solutions
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes.

This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives.

Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes.

The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production.

Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production.

This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations.

This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth.

  • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
  • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
  • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
  • Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams.
  • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
  • Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
  • Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
  • Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
  • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
  • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
  • Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.
  • Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
  • Shadow key calls and client meetings.
  • Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production.
  • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
  • Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.
  • Begin shaping AI solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including forward-deployed AI solutions, Outcome Agents, agentic workflows, enterprise data and knowledge solutions, AI platforms, and managed AI services, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly innovating alongside your clients.
  • Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.
  • Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
  • Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
  • Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
  • Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
  • Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.
  • Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.
  • Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
  • Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
  • Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.
  • Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.
  • Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.
  • Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
  • Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.
  • A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.
  • Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.
  • Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.
  • Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.
  • Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
  • Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
  • Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
  • Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).
  • Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Account Manager
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. title: Founding Sales Development Representative (Southern Europe)
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founding European SDR to help launch and scale Tremendous’ outbound motion internationally. As one of our first international SDR hires, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and booking meetings with high-potential prospects, while helping define how we sell into new European markets.

You will partner closely with Account Executives to generate meetings and act as the first point of contact for prospective customers. This role requires strong outbound execution across email, phone, social, events, and field marketing, with meaningful ownership over account development and early market strategy.

As a founding hire, you will have the opportunity to shape messaging, process, and best practices for international sales while directly impacting pipeline, revenue growth, and Tremendous’ expansion internationally.

What you'll do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through outbound prospecting for the Southern European Market

  • Own your pipeline through cold calling first. The phone is your primary weapon; you'll be expected to make 80+ cold calls per day, book meetings over the phone, and treat every unanswered call as the next opportunity to dial again. Email and LinkedIn support your outreach; they don't replace it

  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing, Strategy, and RevOps teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business

  • Use prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging

  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What you'll bring

  • You're fluent in English as well as Spanish and Italian to engage prospects across southern Europe.

  • You pick up the phone before you open email. Cold calling isn't something you tolerate - it's how you start your day, every day, without being told to.

  • Curious, lifelong learner mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, staying updated on industry trends and best practices, and showing enthusiasm for applying newly acquired knowledge to improve job performance

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: €39k - €45k. OTE: €56k - €62k.

  • Fully remote within Spain

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

title: Product Manager, AI
description:
Millennium Systems International is the leading business management software provider for the beauty and wellness industry and the maker of Meevo. Built over three decades of insight, innovation, and disruption, Meevo is a true all-in-one solution for sophisticated salons, spas, and med spas looking to bolster their successes. Meevo grows with you, supporting your goals and vision every step of the way with reliable tools you can count on today and tomorrow. Meevo is HIPAA compliant and user-friendly, with more than 150,000 users logging in daily to help their salon, spa, and med spa businesses thrive.

We’re just as passionate about our people as we are about our product. MSI is proud to be recognized as a New Jersey Top Workplace and Remote Top Workplace, along with earning Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Awards for Technology Industry, Work-Life Flexibility, Purpose & Values, Employee Well-Being, Employee Appreciation, and Professional Development. We are honored to have been named as a 2025 NJ Top Workplace for the fourth consecutive year. In addition to this core honor, MSI also earned two specialty awards: Top Technology Workplace and Top Remote Workplace, underscoring the company’s culture of innovation and flexibility.

Our values are the principles that guide how we think, act, and win—every day:
  • Innovation
  • Disruption
  • Empowerment
  • Inspire
  • Creativity
  • Integrity
As we expand our reach in the beauty and wellness industry, we are looking for a strategic and innovative Product Manager to lead the development and evolution of our AI powered SaaS solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Set Direction
• Find the manual work that front-desk staff, schedulers, and owners do today across scheduling, service menus, commissions, retail inventory, and rebooking.
Turn it into agent-first capabilities that deliver measurable ROI, where agents take on the work and operators stay in control.
• Prioritize ruthlessly on customer impact. Use AI to synthesize customer feedback, usage data, and market evidence, then make the call without waiting for consensus and own the result.
• Stay current on LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, and tool use. Know their limits well enough to set goals that are both ambitious and realistic.
• Explain product and AI direction clearly to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. Own the Product Intent and Pod Brief
• Author the Product Intent before pod work begins. It covers market context, user problem, desired outcomes, strategic rationale, and how the outcome will be measured in-product.
• Partner with your Pod Lead to turn the Intent into the Pod Brief. This is the pod’s living plan, covering solutions, constraints, acceptance criteria, risk, design approach, and the context AI agents need. It should be crisp enough to build from without added clarification
. • Own user experience decisions but bring in a UX Designer when design system changes are needed.
• Act as the pod’s single point of intake. Route outside requests through yourself and hold them for the next checkpoint rather than shifting priorities mid-build.

Build With Customers
• Spend real time with salon and spa owners, managers, and front-desk staff. Build fluency in how they run day to day, even if the domain is new to you.
• Prototype hands-on with Claude at the fidelity the idea needs and no more, and iterate with engineering in rapid cycles.
• Run the weekly Customer Feedback session. Bring the pod’s open questions to customers, and work what you hear into the next round.
• Run the weekly Stakeholder Feedback session. Decide with the pod what to act on now, what to queue, and what to leave undone, then send stakeholders that decision by end of day.
• Ship valuable increments continuously rather than perfect solutions later.

Measure and Land Outcomes
• Instrument each capability against the outcome you declared: time saved, fewer no shows and cancellations, better chair utilization, and protected retail margin.
• Bring the pod’s work and evidence to each checkpoint with your Pod Lead, from Intent approval through ship to pilot and go to market.
• Own internal UAT with SMEs before any customer sees the work. Close each release with a final demo before pilot.
• Treat documentation as a pod deliverable, so education, sales, and customer success have what they need at pilot, not at launch.
• Partner with Product Marketing well before launch. Make sure they understand what was built, who it serves, and the outcome it delivers, so they can communicate its value to customers clearly.
• Pull in help across Meevo as the work needs it, including other PMs, SMEs, customer success, sales, and education. The pod stays small; its reach does not.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Required
• 5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years shipping AI/ML-powered products to production.
• Domain experience in a vertical SaaS business management platform, including hands on work with integrated payments.
• Agent-first thinking: you frame problems as tasks AI agents can take on, not just features for people to click. You also have the technical depth to hold your own in architecture conversations.
• Builder mentality and speed: you co-create with engineers, prototype, and ship continuously. You make sound calls on imperfect evidence and own the result.
• Fast domain learning: you can get fluent in how salons and spas actually run without months of ramp-up.
• Clear communication with audiences ranging from front-desk staff to executives and investors.
• Experience defining and tracking metrics tied to business outcomes such as retention, utilization, adoption, and revenue.

Preferred
• Experience at software companies serving salons, spas, wellness, hospitality, or other appointment-based businesses, ideally in vertical SaaS.
• Hands-on, shipped work with LLMs, agentic systems, RAG, or AI workflow automation.
• Experience at a growth-stage or PE-backed SaaS company moving from traditional software to AI-native products.
• Understanding of API-first, cloud-native architecture and how it shapes what can ship fast.

Candidates must reside in the U.S. Millennium Systems International participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We Offer:
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holidays
Enjoy a generous 3 weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) that begins accruing with every pay period from your very first day! Plus, you’ll enjoy ten (10) paid holidays throughout 2025, along with five (5) paid sick days and one (1) personal day—because we believe in taking care of you!

Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
Your well-being is a priority! We offer subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, with coverage kicking in quickly. It's all about making sure you stay healthy, happy, and well-cared for.

Life Insurance
Peace of mind for you and your loved ones! We provide Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D). What’s even better? Millennium Systems International fully covers the entire cost—100% on us!

Long-Term and Short-Term Disability Insurance
Stay secure no matter what life brings your way. Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance. And we’ve got your back—Millennium Systems International covers the full cost of Long-Term Disability at 100%.

401(k) Retirement Plan
Plan for your future with confidence! You’ll be eligible to enroll in our robust 401(k) plan. When you do, you’ll enjoy a 100% match on up to 4% of your contributions, thanks to our Safe Harbor plan. It’s our way of helping you build a brighter tomorrow.

Learning & Development Opportunities
We foster a culture of growth and professional excellence. As part of our benefits, we offer unlimited access to Udemy’s online courses, helping you refine your skills, explore new areas, and advance your career. Whether you're deepening your expertise or learning new technologies, we’re here to support your development every step of the way.

title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert
description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

DEPT is a remote-first organization. For this role, we’re looking for someone located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone to align with team and client schedules.

Planning

If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Role Overview


Palo Alto Networks is seeking an experienced, strategic, and proactive Senior Manager, Public Policy & Government Affairs responsible for Australia and New Zealand, based in Australia, preferably in Sydney or Canberra.


In this role, you will lead engagement with Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments, the New Zealand Government, parliamentary stakeholders, and key cybersecurity, national security, and digital government agencies. Priority relationships will include Australia’s Department of Home Affairs and the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD), including its Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC), and New Zealand’s Government Communications Security Bureau (GCSB), including its National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC).


You will work cross-functionally with executive leadership, Go to Market Teams, Product Management, and Threat Intelligence (Unit 42), to shape public policy outcomes that foster innovation, protect critical infrastructure, and strengthen trust in the Australian and New Zealand digital economies. Reporting to the Vice President, JAPAC, you will coordinate with regional and global public policy colleagues to align local engagement with broader business and policy priorities.


Key Responsibilities


Policy Strategy & Advocacy: Design and execute strategic advocacy initiatives across Australia and New Zealand on issues including AI security, supply chain risk management, zero trust, incident reporting, critical infrastructure resilience, and cloud security. Engage with Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand ministries, departments, and agencies.


Government & Parliamentary Engagement: Develop trusted relationships with ministers’ offices, senior public servants, relevant parliamentary committees, and government cybersecurity leaders in both countries. Priority stakeholders will include:

  • Australia: The Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, the Department of Defence, the Department of Industry, Science and Resources, the Digital Transformation Agency, and relevant State and Territory cybersecurity and digital government bodies.
  • New Zealand: GCSB/NCSC, the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet, the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, the Department of Internal Affairs, and relevant defence, education, health and digital government stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 8 plus years of relevant experience in cybersecurity public policy, technology policy, or government affairs, preferably spanning government and the private technology sector.
  • Experience within Australian or New Zealand government, a ministerial office, parliamentary committee, or a relevant cybersecurity, national security, or digital government agency is highly alued. Experience working across both markets is desirable.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Deep familiarity with the Australian and New Zealand cybersecurity nand technology policy landscapes, including Australia’s ASD Information Security Manual, Essential Eight, and Information Security Registered Assessors Program (IRAP), and New Zealand’s Information Security Manual and Protective Security Requirements.
  • Strong understanding of critical infrastructure security, government security and cloud assurance settings, software supply chain security, and emerging AI policy frameworks.
  • Familiarity with international cybersecurity frameworks and their relevance to both markets is also desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Computer Science, Law, or a related field.
  • Exceptional written, analytical, and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to synthesise complex technical security topics for non-technical policymakers, senior government officials, and C-suite executives.
  • An established network of trusted relationships across Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand government stakeholders.
  • Strong relationships with the Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, GCSB/NCSC, relevant parliamentary committees, and cybersecurity, national security, and digital government agencies are particularly valuable.
  • Based in Australia, with Sydney or Canberra preferred, and willing to travel regularly to Canberra, other Australian capitals, and New Zealand, particularly Wellington, for government and stakeholder engagement.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Principal Product Designer - AI & Enterprise UX (Virtual, US)
description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

The Opportunity

Enterprise software should be as intuitive, engaging, and seamless as the consumer experiences people use every day. At Avaya, we’re bringing that standard to enterprise customer experience by transforming Avaya Infinity into a next-generation Connection Center—one that goes beyond traditional contact center workflows to create more intelligent, connected, and personalized customer interactions.

Our vision is built around three principles: Connections, Context, and Insights. By bringing together real-time data, customer history, and AI-powered capabilities, Avaya Infinity will help organizations deliver more meaningful interactions across web, desktop, mobile, and AI-driven workflows.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Designer – AI & Enterprise UX to help define and bring this vision to life. This is an opportunity to shape the experience of a strategic enterprise platform—not only designing new capabilities, but reimagining existing workflows, modernizing the user experience, and establishing the design systems and standards that will guide the platform forward.

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll operate at the intersection of product strategy, design, and engineering. You’ll turn complex workflows into intuitive experiences, use rapid prototyping and AI-enabled design tools to accelerate decision-making, and partner closely with engineering to translate design intent into high-quality products. Your influence will extend beyond individual features to the overall usability, consistency, and evolution of Avaya Infinity.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the Avaya Infinity Experience: Translate the vision for Connections, Context, and Insights into intuitive, human-centered experiences across web, desktop (Windows/Mac), and mobile—raising the bar for enterprise software usability and design.

  • Design New Capabilities and Modernize Existing Experiences: Lead UX and product design for key Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives while identifying and addressing usability gaps, outdated workflows, and inconsistencies across the platform.

  • Accelerate Innovation Through Rapid Prototyping: Use interactive prototypes, AI-enabled design tools, and iterative testing to validate concepts early, clarify requirements, and help engineering teams move from idea to implementation faster.

  • Build Scalable Design Systems and Engineering Workflows: Establish and evolve Figma components, variables, design tokens, and handoff standards in close partnership with engineering. Ensure designs translate effectively into production across React, Electron, and native applications while minimizing rework and improving implementation quality.

  • Design the Next Generation of AI-Powered Experiences: Create intuitive ways to incorporate real-time agent assistance, automated interaction summaries, predictive routing, and generative AI capabilities—making complex information actionable without overwhelming users.

  • Lead UX Strategy Across Product and Engineering: Own the UX roadmap for Avaya Infinity, influence product priorities, and advocate for user-centered design in executive reviews. Partner across Product Management, Solution Architecture, and Engineering to align design decisions with customer needs, technical feasibility, and business outcomes.

What You Bring

  • Enterprise Product Design Experience: Significant experience designing complex B2B software across web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Experience with CCaaS, UCaaS, CRM, or other enterprise SaaS products is highly valued.

  • A Strong UX Portfolio: Demonstrated ability to transform complex workflows and information-dense interfaces into intuitive, modern experiences. Your portfolio shows how you balance usability, visual design, and business requirements to simplify the user experience.

  • Strategic Thinking and Hands-On Execution: Ability to move seamlessly between defining a long-term UX vision and delivering high-quality designs for immediate product priorities. You know how to modernize existing experiences while building a foundation for future capabilities.

  • Advanced Figma and Design Systems Expertise: Strong command of Figma, including variables, design tokens, component libraries, auto-layout, and reusable design patterns. Experience establishing scalable design systems and integrating design workflows with frontend development is essential.

  • Rapid Prototyping and AI-Enabled Design: Experience using interactive prototyping, iterative testing, and emerging AI-powered design tools to validate concepts quickly, resolve ambiguity, and accelerate product development.

  • Close Collaboration with Engineering: Proven ability to partner with frontend engineers to evaluate technical feasibility, communicate design intent, and deliver implementation-ready specifications across modern web, desktop, and native applications.

  • Product and Customer Experience Acumen: Understanding of complex customer interaction workflows, omnichannel experiences, real-time data, and analytics. You connect design decisions to customer needs, product strategy, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Accessibility and Inclusive Design: Strong understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and experience incorporating inclusive design principles into complex enterprise applications from the outset.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing AI-powered product experiences, including real-time agent assistance, contextual recommendations, automated summaries, or generative AI workflows.

  • Familiarity with React, Electron, native application architectures, and design-to-code workflows.

  • Experience leading design strategy and influencing product and engineering decisions as a senior individual contributor in a cross-functional environment.

How Success Is Measured

  • Design Delivery and Engineering Velocity: Deliver high-quality, implementation-ready designs for Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives on schedule. Use rapid prototyping, clear specifications, and close engineering collaboration to target a 25–30% improvement in design-to-code velocity.

  • Platform Modernization and UX Improvement: Evaluate existing Infinity experiences, identify the highest-impact usability challenges, and establish a prioritized UX improvement roadmap. Reduce friction in legacy workflows while improving consistency, usability, and scalability across the platform.

  • Design System Adoption and Handoff Quality: Establish consistent Figma components, design tokens, and design-to-code workflows across web, desktop, and mobile. Reduce ambiguity, minimize developer rework, and improve the fidelity of implemented designs.

  • Measurable User Experience Impact: Improve usability through measurable reductions in cognitive load, unnecessary interaction steps, and task completion time. Track progress through usability testing, System Usability Scale (SUS) scores, and agent satisfaction (Agent CSAT), where applicable.

Why Join Avaya?

At Avaya, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise customer experience—not simply refine existing interfaces. You’ll help transform Avaya Infinity into a modern, AI-enabled Connection Center that brings together Connections, Context, and Insights to make customer interactions more intuitive, intelligent, and meaningful.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you can influence product strategy, establish the UX direction for a strategic platform, and see your work move from concept to production. You’ll combine creative ownership and hands-on design with close collaboration across Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering.

If you’re energized by simplifying complex technology, challenging legacy design conventions, and using emerging AI capabilities to create better user experiences, Avaya offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on software that supports customer interactions around the world.

The pay range for this opportunity is up to $187,800 in total compensation, inclusive of base salary and bonus. Actual total compensation will vary based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

Experience

5 - 8 Years of Experience

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Footer

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. • Develop and execute an enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy aligned with LUX Infusion's growth plans, operating priorities, and long-term workforce needs.

• Create hiring forecasts, capacity models, prioritization frameworks, and recruiting resource plans that improve organizational readiness and reduce reactive hiring.
• Advise executive leadership on talent availability, geographic labor-market conditions, hiring risks, recruiting investments, and workforce implications of business decisions.
• Establish consistent, equitable, and legally compliant standards for job intake, candidate evaluation, interviewing, selection, and hiring decisions nationwide.
• Support workforce planning and talent acquisition needs for acquisitions, integrations, and new-market expansion as a recurring, core component of this role, not an incidental one.

Sourcing, Pipeline Development, and Employer Brand
• Build sustainable talent pipelines for critical, recurring, and difficult-to-fill positions across clinical, operational, professional, and leadership functions.
• Develop data-driven sourcing strategies using labor-market intelligence, geographic analysis, candidate and conversion data, referrals, professional networks, educational partnerships, and digital channels.
• Measure source quality and channel effectiveness to focus recruiting resources on approaches that produce qualified, durable hires drawn from broad candidate pools.
• Develop and maintain a compelling employer value proposition and partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen the LUX Infusion employment brand.
• Create strategies for passive-candidate engagement, talent-community management, and market-specific outreach within a consistent national framework.

Recruiting Operations, Technology, and Onboarding
• Evaluate and optimize the end-to-end recruiting process, including requisition approval, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offers, pre-employment requirements, and transition to onboarding.
• Establish recruiting service levels, standardized workflows, clear decision rights, and accountability for recruiters, hiring managers, and business partners.
• Lead the effective use and ongoing optimization of the applicant tracking system, including Greenhouse configuration, workflows, data integrity, reporting, user adoption, and compliance.
• Evaluate recruiting technology and automation opportunities that improve scheduling, candidate engagement, analytics, reporting, and team productivity, and confirm that any automated or AI-assisted screening tools comply with applicable law.
• Partner with Human Resources, IT, Compliance, and Operations to create a coordinated preboarding and onboarding experience, including licensure and credential verification and federal exclusion screening where applicable, that reduces delays and pre-start attrition and accelerates new-hire readiness.
• Use candidate and new-hire feedback to continuously improve the candidate, preboarding, and onboarding experience.

Analytics, KPIs, and Continuous Improvement
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive talent acquisition measurement framework, including KPIs, dashboards, targets, benchmarks, and reporting standards.
• Track and analyze measures such as hiring-plan attainment, time to fill, time to hire, cost per hire, source effectiveness, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance, candidate withdrawal, recruiter productivity, quality of hire, early retention, and stakeholder satisfaction.
• Conduct regular business reviews with leadership to assess performance, forecast needs, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions or resource changes.
• Ensure data integrity and disciplined system use so recruiting analytics are accurate, timely, consistent, and actionable.
• Develop leading and predictive indicators that allow the organization to anticipate hiring challenges rather than react after vacancies affect operations.

Leadership, Partnership, and Compensation Review
• Lead, coach, and develop the talent acquisition team, establishing clear expectations, performance standards, operating rhythms, and accountability.
• Serve as a strategic advisor to hiring leaders and provide training, tools, and guidance that improve interview quality, decision-making, and candidate engagement.
• Partner with Human Resources and Finance to evaluate compensation competitiveness using market data, internal equity, candidate feedback, offer outcomes, and hiring performance.
• Recommend adjustments to compensation ranges, geographic differentials, hiring incentives, or offer practices when supported by market and performance data.
• Assess when external search firms, agencies, contract recruiters, or other resources are warranted and manage those relationships and investments effectively.
• Manage recruiting spend within the approved annual budget.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Represent LUX Infusion at recruiting events, professional conferences, educational programs, and community partnerships, as appropriate.
• Support enterprise projects and special workforce initiatives as requested.
• Maintain professional knowledge of recruiting practices, labor-market trends, technology, and applicable employment laws.
• Participate in quality assurance, compliance, and process audits as directed.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Analytics, or equivalent experience in a related field.
• Minimum of 10 years of progressive talent acquisition or human resources experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership or enterprise recruiting role.
• Demonstrated experience developing and executing talent acquisition strategies across multiple states or on a national scale.
• Strong background in workforce planning, recruiting analytics, dashboard development, and the design and implementation of KPIs.
• Proven ability to analyze recruiting data, identify trends and operational risks, and translate findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
• Experience building proactive pipelines and sourcing strategies for high-volume, specialized, clinical, professional, and leadership positions.
• Demonstrated success improving recruiting processes, technology, candidate experience, and hiring-manager effectiveness.
• Demonstrated knowledge of compensation benchmarking, market analysis, internal equity considerations, and offer strategy.
• Knowledge of federal, state, and local laws and regulations applicable to recruiting and hiring across multiple jurisdictions, including pay transparency, fair-chance and background check, salary history, and automated employment decision tool requirements.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, project-management, and team-leadership skills.

QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED
• Experience administering or materially optimizing Greenhouse ATS.
• Experience supporting healthcare, infusion, specialty pharmacy, or another highly regulated and competitive labor environment.
• Experience in a rapidly growing, geographically dispersed, or private equity-backed organization.
• Experience supporting acquisitions, new-market expansion, organizational integration, or high-volume growth initiatives.
• Advanced degree or professional certification in Human Resources, talent acquisition, analytics, or a related discipline.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• Enterprise and strategic thinking

• Attention to detail

• Workforce planning and business acumen
• KPI development and analytical judgment
• Talent pipeline and sourcing strategy
• Process design and continuous improvement
• Executive communication and influence
• Team leadership and talent development
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Change management and operational discipline
• Professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment

Performance Measures
• Achievement of approved hiring plans and critical-role staffing priorities.
• Time to fill, time to hire, and vacancy aging by role, market, and business unit.
• Pipeline health, source effectiveness, funnel conversion, and qualified-candidate flow.
• Offer acceptance, candidate withdrawal, and pre-start attrition rates.
• Quality of hire and new-hire retention.
• Recruiter productivity, process compliance, and data integrity.
• Hiring manager and candidate satisfaction.
• Effectiveness of recruiting investments, including cost per hire and agency utilization.

Communication Skills
• Communicates clearly, persuasively, and appropriately with executives, hiring leaders, candidates, and team members; listens and seeks clarification; presents complex workforce and recruiting data in an accessible manner; and prepares concise, accurate written communications and executive-level reports.

Computer Skills

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe infusion care deserves more light—more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
HR & Recruitment Coordinator

Start your career in HR and Talent Acquisition with BioPhorum

Are you a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career in HR? Are you naturally organised, curious, proactive and someone who enjoys working with people?

We're looking for an enthusiastic Graduate Resourcer & HR Assistant to join our People team at BioPhorum.

This is a great opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants to gain hands-on experience across recruitment and HR, develop new skills and make a real contribution to a growing international business.

You don't need previous HR or recruitment experience. What matters most to us is your attitude, willingness to learn and desire to get stuck in.

About BioPhorum

BioPhorum is an international organisation that brings together leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to collaborate, share knowledge and solve some of the industry's biggest challenges.

Our people are at the heart of what we do, and our People team plays an important role in attracting, supporting and developing the talent that helps our business grow.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied role where you'll gain exposure to both recruitment and the wider HR function. You'll work closely with the Talent Partner and wider People team, learning how we attract great people, deliver a positive candidate experience and support employees throughout their time with BioPhorum.

Your responsibilities will include:

Recruitment and Talent Acquisition

  • Supporting the recruitment process from initial application through to interview and appointment.
  • Reviewing applications and identifying candidates who match our requirements.
  • Helping to source and engage potential candidates through different recruitment channels.
  • Coordinating interviews, communicating with candidates and keeping everyone updated throughout the process.
  • Supporting the preparation of interview materials and recruitment documentation.
  • Maintaining accurate candidate information and updating our recruitment systems.
  • Helping to ensure candidates have a positive experience when engaging with BioPhorum.

HR and People Support

  • Providing general administrative support across the employee lifecycle.
  • Supporting onboarding activities for new starters.
  • Maintaining accurate employee records and updating our HR system.
  • Preparing HR documentation and supporting day-to-day People team activities.
  • Helping with wider HR projects and initiatives, including employee engagement and internal communications.

You'll also have the opportunity to get involved in different projects, learn how the People team operates and build your understanding of the wider business.

What we're looking for

We're much more interested in your potential, attitude and approach than how much experience you already have.

You'll ideally be someone who:

  • Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent experience, and is keen to build a career in HR or recruitment.
  • Is proactive and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.
  • Is naturally organised, able to manage different priorities and has a good eye for detail.
  • Has strong communication skills and enjoys interacting with different people.
  • Is curious, asks questions and is keen to understand how things work.
  • Is confident using technology and comfortable learning new systems.
  • Takes responsibility for their work and follows things through.
  • Is positive, adaptable and happy to get involved wherever needed.

You don't need to tick every box. If you have the right attitude and are excited about developing a career in HR, we'd love to hear from you.

What will you get out of it?

This isn't just an entry-level administration role. It's an opportunity to build a strong foundation for a career in HR and Talent Acquisition.

You'll gain:

  • Hands-on experience across recruitment and the wider employee lifecycle.
  • Exposure to different areas of HR and how they support a growing international business.
  • The opportunity to work closely with experienced HR and Talent professionals.
  • Support, guidance and the chance to develop your skills and confidence.
  • Opportunities to contribute to projects and take ownership of your own responsibilities.
  • A role where you can make a genuine contribution and see the impact of your work.

Why BioPhorum?

At BioPhorum, we believe in bringing people together, sharing knowledge and making a difference. You'll be joining a collaborative team where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, take initiative and develop.

If you're looking for a role where you can learn, grow, challenge yourself and build a career in HR, this could be the perfect place to start.

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you. You don't need to have your career all figured out – just bring your enthusiasm, curiosity and willingness to learn.

title: Senior SecOps Engineer
description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfil their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for an Infrastructure & Security Operations Engineer on behalf of our client to strengthen cyber defense, reduce organizational risk, and drive core security improvements across cloud, identity, endpoint, and server environments.

In this role, you will play a central part in vulnerability remediation, incident response, security monitoring, and infrastructure hardening. You will collaborate closely with infrastructure, cloud, service delivery, and third-party vendors to turn security priorities and audit findings into verified, production-ready fixes.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Security Operations (SecOps), Infrastructure Security, or Systems Administration.

  • Strong working knowledge of hybrid enterprise environments (Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, M365, Azure, or AWS).

  • Demonstrated experience with vulnerability scanning/management tools and patch coordination across multiple platforms.

  • Practical experience working with SIEM, EDR/XDR, or managed SOC/MDR escalation workflows.

  • Proven ability to coordinate technical remediation across internal teams and third-party managed service providers.

  • Strong analytical troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to documentation and tracking.

  • Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Nice-to-Have Skills:

 

  • Hands-on experience with tools like Microsoft Defender XDR, Sentinel, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Qualys, Tenable, or Rapid7.

title: New Business Manager

  • Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 4 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency, a martech company (e.g. SEO, content, analytics, or marketing automation software), or at a company selling into agencies.

  • Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting.

  • Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs).

  • No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing.

  • Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that.

  • Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools.

  • Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above).

  • Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience.

Compensation: $36,000–45,500/year base (excl. VAT, where applicable), plus a bonus system.

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław, Poland.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
